documentation: Document packages and exported declarations; start declaration comments with the declared name.
State error behavior, ownership, cancellation and concurrency guarantees where relevant.
Use runnable Example functions for non-obvious public usage when practical.
rules: Group standard-library and other imports; avoid redundant package-name prefixes.
Return error last and handle it; do not use panic for expected recoverable failure.
Pass context.Context first and propagate cancellation along the call chain.
Define small interfaces at the consumer when needed; avoid interfaces for hypothetical implementations.
Make goroutine lifetimes explicit and release resources with appropriate cleanup.
